stem.text: The relative atomic mass of copper is 63.5.
Which chart is a correct mass spectrum that would lead to this value?

A.alt: Mass spectrum: one peak at m/e 63.5 with abundance 100%, axis m/e 61 to 66.

B.alt: Mass spectrum: peaks at m/e 62 (17%), 63 (33%) and 65 (50%).

C.alt: Mass spectrum: peaks at m/e 63 (74%) and 65 (26%).

D.alt: Mass spectrum: peaks at m/e 61 (33%), 62 (22%), 65 (12%) and 66 (33%).
